messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Verdantis (Enterprise) — Dedicated EU cluster showing spike in 5xxs and request timeouts. Rate of 5xxs ~12% over last 5m, affecting embeddings and generation endpoints. Auto-escalate to on-call.

incident-bot: Alert details: cluster: eu-dedicated-verdantis-01, error: upstream:5xx, affected-models: redwood/gpt-7b-quant, ingress: customer-prd, SLO risk: degraded for high-priority traffic. Links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/6290012345

sara_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Starting triage now. @mike_sre can you confirm whether this is capacity-related or a runtime regression? :eyes:

mike_sre: Looking at metrics — high GPU mem pressure on a subset of nodes + elevated p95 latency on kv-cache path. No recent kernel rollouts in EU region in last 24h. Could be a slow degradation after a batch of large prompt traffic from Verdantis.

dmitri_eng: I see a burst from tenant verdantis-prod around 6290009000-6290010000, many long-context requests (>= 4k tokens). Autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough due to policy min-instances pinned.

ops_lead: If autoscaler is pinned we should temporarily bump capacity and enable fallback routes. Propose: +4 machines in eu-dedicated pool and enable model-variant fallback to gpt-7b-int8 for Verdantis only. @sara_oncall do the bump and notify CS.

sara_oncall: Copy. @mike_sre I'm running scale command now.

sara_oncall: ```
# scale command
infra-scale --cluster eu-dedicated-verdantis-01 --add 4 --reason "5xx spike - autoscale lag"
```

incident-bot: Runbook step: if 5xx >10% for >5m, scale + fallback and send customer-facing status update.

lina_cs: Drafting account-specific update for Verdantis. Need a short impact blurb + list of affected routes for their ops contact. Proposed draft below — want SRE wording before we send.

lina_cs: "Verdantis operations — We are experiencing degraded inference responses for your EU-dedicated deployment. Our team is actively scaling capacity and routing traffic to a compatible model to restore normal responses. We expect service restoration within 30 minutes. We will follow up with a detailed timeline and post-incident summary."

mathew_support: Include explicit impacted endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Also note affected business impact: delayed batch scoring and reduced throughput for real-time API.

mike_sre: Minor wording tweak: call out that we enabled a compatible quantized variant as fallback (reduced throughput/quality tradeoff). Suggested sentence: "We have temporarily routed traffic to a compatible, quantized model variant to preserve availability while we scale capacity; this may result in marginally different outputs."

lina_cs: Updated. New draft: "Verdantis operations — We are experiencing degraded inference responses for your EU-dedicated deployment impacting /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Our team has temporarily routed traffic to a compatible, quantized model variant to preserve availability while we scale capacity; this may result in marginally different outputs. We are also adding capacity and expect restoration within 30 minutes. A follow-up with root cause and mitigation will be shared." :white_check_mark:

ops_lead: Good. Who's sending to Verdantis primary contacts? @lina_cs you + @mathew_support coordinate. Use the tailored notify template below and add account contacts.

lina_cs: Adding contact routing list: 
- Primary ops: ops@verdantis.co (Joanna Phillips)
- Secondary: eng-contacts@verdantis.co (team)
- CSM: vera.care@verdantis.co (Vera Care)
- Pager fallback: +44 20 7000 5555 (on-call rotation)

mathew_support: Sending for review now. I'll cc account exec and legal for visibility.

sara_oncall: Quick status update for internal status page and slack ops: "Incident 6290012345: Verdantis EU-dedicated - 5xx spike. Scaling + fallback enabled. Serving degraded but available for most requests. Next update in 15m."

incident-bot: Autoscale action: infra-scale succeeded, nodes added. Verifying load balancing and model routing.

mike_sre: Confirmed new nodes registered and traffic draining from overloaded pods. KV-cache hot-keys still present; starting targeted cache warmup for affected prefixes.

dmitri_eng: Also enabled model-variant fallback for verdantis-prod: routing rule applied to tenant id. Monitor for regressions in output.

lina_cs: Preparing email template to send (customer-facing). Draft below — please comment if OK to send.

lina_cs: "Hello Joanna,

We wanted to inform you that your Verdantis EU-dedicated deployment experienced degraded inference responses beginning at 2026-03-17T12:34Z. Our engineers have applied capacity increases and routed traffic to a compatible model variant to maintain availability. Impact: intermittent 5xx responses and increased latency affecting /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. What we did: scaled the dedicated pool, enabled a quantized fallback, and warmed KV caches. Expected next steps: continued monitoring; full restoration expected within 30 minutes. We will provide a post-incident summary with timeline and mitigation within 24 hours.

If you have immediate questions, please reply to this thread or reach out to ops@redwood.com.

— Redwood Status Team"

mike_sre: Fine from SRE side. Add a short technical appendix link to the incident postmortem later.

ops_lead: Approved to send. @mathew_support please send the email and mark the status page as "Degraded" with our short blurb.

mathew_support: Sent to Joanna and CCs. Status page updated: https://status.redwood/incident/6290012345 (status: Degraded)

incident-bot: Note: short-term mitigation in place. Continue to monitor for 30m. If 5xx drops under 2% and p95 latency stabilizes, prepare rollback of fallback routing.

sara_oncall: Monitoring — p95 improved from 2.4s -> 1.1s after scale. 5xx rate down to 3.2%. Will re-check in 10m and propose rollback if stable.

lina_cs: Customer acknowledged receipt and thanked team for fast action.

mike_sre: Add ops note: follow-up to runbook: evaluate autoscale policy thresholds for verdantis (lower cooldown / higher burst cap) and add a targeted cache eviction for long-context keys.

dmitri_eng: Filed follow-up ticket: INFRA-4781 (policy tuning + cache eviction automation).

ops_lead: Good. Closing this paging thread unless anything else comes up. Final internal update in 30m then post-incident summary. :lock:

sara_oncall: Thanks all — staying on watch.

incident-bot: Incident 6290012345 status: Mitigated (monitoring).
